display_long_description:
📖 About the Game
Monke Mountain is a VR climbing adventure built for both solo players and 2-player co-op. Take on the role of  a nimble ape and conquer three distinct realms — Ground, Sky, and Space — with nothing but your own two hands.Climb, leap, and survive your way to the legendary Golden Banana, and complete an interstellar pilgrimage    only an ape could dream of.

  🎮 Key Features
  - 🧗 True Hands-On Climbing — Immersive VR hand-tracking
with no stick locomotion. Every grip is decided by     your own hands.
  - 🌍 A Three-Act Journey — Ground → Sky → Space. Environments and challenges escalate as you climb higher.    
  - 👤 Solo or Co-op — Take on the climb alone, or join online to explore the stars
  - 👾 Alien Threats — Dodge UFO lasers and incoming stones from Slime creatures in the final act.
  - 🍌 The Golden Banana — A clear, myth-driven goal that guides your pilgrimage from start to finish.
  - ⚡ Physics-Driven Feedback — Real hand collisions, weighty falls, and tense stamina management.
